claim: Exports claim trails as Markdown and CSV for free.
sandbox: open /?demo=1 from a fresh browser context; download both exports and assert the shipped sample content is present

claim: Demo sample data is separate from your real workspace and can be discarded.
sandbox: seed a real trail, open /?demo=1, assert only demo records render, then Start for real and assert demo storage is gone

claim: Your claim and source content stays in this browser.
sandbox: edit a sample trail in /?demo=1 while recording requests; assert every request is same-origin

claim: Create and export a claim trail without an account.
sandbox: open / from a fresh browser context; create, complete, and export a trail without any sign-in or account step

claim: Create, revise, search, filter, and reversibly delete claim trails, including counterevidence and readiness status.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; create complete counterevidence, edit it, search and filter it, delete it, undo, and assert status throughout

claim: The sample workspace works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: new browser context; open /?demo=1, wait for the service worker, set offline, reload, and assert the sample trail and offline notice render

claim: Markdown and CSV exports keep working offline after the first visit.
sandbox: new browser context; cache /?demo=1, go offline, reload, download both formats, and assert sample content in each file

claim: The $18 Instructor kit opens Sociobot/Dodo checkout.
sandbox: open the home page and assert the advertised checkout endpoint responds with a 303 redirect to checkout.dodopayments.com without following it

claim: An active Instructor kit adds a local cohort pulse, course labels in Markdown, and 7/30/90-day retention choices.
sandbox: seed a current cached license verdict plus old/recent local trails; assert cohort counts, automatic deletion, every retention choice, and a labeled Markdown export

claim: A visit sends one bodyless page-count request; claim and source content is not sent to the backend, which stores only a date and count.
sandbox: record requests while creating a private trail; assert the sole POST is same-origin and bodyless, then assert the SQLite page_views table has only day and count columns

claim: Delete all local data removes trails, settings, page-count state, and the Instructor kit credential.
sandbox: seed every product-owned storage namespace, use the in-product deletion control, and assert no product-owned key remains

claim: A license token is sent only to the Sociobot product endpoint and a valid verdict is reused for at most one day.
sandbox: mock the Sociobot response, assert the exact product-scoped URL, then verify a second check uses the cached daily verdict without another request
